scenarios.name: Finish a sketch from a tabs-only ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in the MCAD Software
an existing sketch is being edited in the MCAD Software
the Sketch ribbon is minimized to tabs
the user clicks the Sketch tab
the Sketch command groups appear temporarily beneath the tabs
the temporary ribbon includes the Finish action
sketch editing ends and the part model is displayed
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
